name: Anja Verrin
bio: Verrin keeps Kestrel's oldest contract marks in a paper ledger. She has outlived enough of them to know which promises survive contact.

personality.label: Cool head
personality.description: Keeps promises in a paper ledger. Calm under pressure; impatient with grand speeches.

move: Steady pace. We all reach the next mark.
Another road in the ledger. Moving.
attack: One problem at a time. Taking this one.
I promised we would get through. Guns on target.
guard: I have this stretch. Keep your promise on the other side.
hold_fire: Hold fire. A live promise is worth more than a dead target.
investigate: A blank in the ledger. Let us see what belongs there.
heavy_fire: Taking sustained fire. A little cover, please.
They are testing my patience and my plate. Repositioning would help.
